results.name: Home: three workspace entry points are visible
Home: Quick guide opens and returns to main menu
Pattern setup: Repeat is chosen before entry; Design setup is inside the editor
Pattern: Select tool drives the real engine
Pattern: Brush controls, all brush styles and stamp choices work
Pattern: stroke stabilisation changes new brush geometry and persists
Pattern: Brush drawing, Undo and Redo change the real canvas
Pattern: pen pressure stores per-point width data and exports variable-width SVG
Pattern: pressure width remains compatible with Ink, Pencil and Marker
Pattern: Eraser exposes size and opacity and activates real eraser
Pattern: Fill and Gradient Fill switch the real engine tools
Pattern: bucket fill makes an editable transparent-region vector and round-trips exports
Pattern: bucket tolerance changes matching colour extent
Pattern: bucket fill crosses straight, half-drop and brick repeat seams correctly
Pattern: Canvas zoom buttons work and Fit fits the tile
Pattern: Shape tool exposes Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, width and fill
Pattern: Image button opens the file picker and imports a test SVG
Pattern: scatter preserves manual items, freezes, and respects seam-aware spacing
Pattern: saved variation restores design state and Undo reverses the apply
Pattern: colourway manager renames, duplicates, compares and exports without changing work
Pattern: Selection transform, duplicate, arrange, snap and delete controls work
Pattern: multi-select groups, moves, persists, duplicates and ungroups
Pattern: selected editable marks recolour and matching colours replace project-wide
Pattern: Colour panel updates ink, adds a swatch and exposes eyedropper
Pattern: Layers add, rename, opacity, flags, duplicate, reorder and delete work
Pattern: specialist Pattern controls proxy to the repeat engine
Pattern: product-scale preview responds to physical tile and product size
Pattern: scale preview marks half-drop and brick export repeat-cell dimensions
Pattern: Alpha Lock preserves layer alpha through paint, recolour, eraser and reopen
Pattern: clipping mask constrains artwork in PNG preview and SVG export
Pattern: Preview button toggles the repeat preview
Pattern: every export/open action works
Pattern: Fullscreen keeps tools functional while preserving the large canvas
Pattern: Projects button returns to project home
Project setup: Cancel returns a fresh generic editor route to project home
Project home: recent project entry appears after saved work
Open Project: saved-project resume prompt exposes Continue and Start new
Doodle desktop: preview shortcut is removed and transparent export is stated
Motifs: editable Doodle artwork can be reused in Pattern
Integration: pressure motif, grouping, clipping, save-reopen and exports stay compatible
Hardening: motif group survives flip, recolour, clipping, variation and export chain
Hardening: frozen scatter group and variation survive save-reopen
Hardening: 40-state undo cap remains stable after 45 edits
Pattern: a new tile opens centred with its grid in portrait and landscape
Doodle landscape: opens directly and hides Pattern-only controls
Doodle landscape: visible tools are usable
Doodle fullscreen: camera-safe rail, tools, context and palettes remain usable
Doodle portrait: rotate-to-landscape gate is shown
